name: Boost Potency
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 2, druid 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 plant or creature touched/level
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This spell increases the DC for any of the target’s natural poisons by 1 per two caster levels (minimum 1). This spell can be cast only on a living plant or animal that produces a natural poison of some type.
